h1: Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng — 3-Star with Pool from ฿800, Directly Opposite Ramkhamhaeng University
intro: In a neighbourhood where hotel pools are genuinely rare, Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng offers not one but two outdoor swimming pools, a gym, a spa, and a full-service restaurant — all from around ฿800–900 per night. The 256-room property at 8 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 35 sits directly opposite Ramkhamhaeng University, making it the obvious base for anyone visiting students, working in the area, or catching a concert or sports event at Rajamangala National Stadium (a 3-minute Grab ride away). ARL Hua Mak station, which links to Suvarnabhumi Airport in around 27 minutes, is roughly 1.5 km away. All 256 rooms went through a renovation in 2020, offering a cleaner, more modern aesthetic than the pre-renovation era. A composite rating of around 8.0 out of 10 from 400-plus guest reviews reflects a hotel that mostly delivers — with a few caveats worth knowing. This review is compiled from real guest experiences on Booking.com, Agoda and Trip.com.

body.html: Overview and who it suits — Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng occupies a distinctive position in the Hua Mak hotel market: it is one of the very few 3-star options in the Ramkhamhaeng area that comes with two outdoor pools, a gym, a sauna, and a spa. Sitting directly opposite Ramkhamhaeng University on Soi 35, it draws parents visiting university students, business travellers working in Bang Kapi, families who need a pool and free parking, and concert-goers heading to Rajamangala National Stadium. The hotel's composite review score of around 8.0/10 from 400-plus guests tells a story of a property that consistently delivers better-than-expected value — though with some recurring weak points that guests should factor in before booking.

Location and getting around — The hotel is at 8 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 35, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240. Rajamangala National Stadium — Bangkok's largest sports and concert venue — is approximately 1.7 km away and reachable in 3–5 minutes by Grab, which is far enough that you can walk back after a late show if needed. ARL Hua Mak (A4) sits around 1.5 km from the hotel (3–4 minutes by Grab or motorcycle taxi) and connects directly to Suvarnabhumi Airport in about 27 minutes — handy for early check-in flights. The MRT Yellow Line at Hua Mak Station is also within reach, running the length of Lat Phrao to Samrong. The Mall LifeStore Ramkhamhaeng — the neighbourhood's main shopping and dining anchor — is roughly 2 km away. The hotel is inside a soi rather than on the main road, so getting around requires Grab or motorcycle taxis for anywhere beyond walking distance.
"The pool is beautiful and peaceful — one of the best things about staying here. Staff were friendly and really helpful. Room was spacious and clean, good value for the price."

Rooms and amenities — Following the 2020 renovation, the 256 rooms are divided into Deluxe Rooms (26 sq m, one double or two single beds), Deluxe Double Rooms (two beds, good for small groups), Family Rooms (king bed plus two single beds — popular with families), and Executive Suites. All rooms include a sofa and writing desk, soundproof windows, a separate toilet and shower, hairdryer, and slippers. Real guest reviews consistently flag that rooms feel larger and newer than the price suggests. The hotel's headline facilities — two outdoor pools, a fitness centre, sauna, spa, restaurant, lobby bar, and free parking — represent an unusually full package for the Ramkhamhaeng corridor. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout; bicycle rental is complimentary; 24-hour room service is available.

Dining — The hotel restaurant opens daily for a breakfast buffet from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM at ฿220 per person (not included in room rates). Guest reviews generally find breakfast good value and reasonably varied. The lobby bar offers drinks in the evenings. Beyond the hotel, Soi Ramkhamhaeng 35 and the surrounding streets have a strong student-area food culture — street stalls, noodle shops, and convenience stores are within easy walking distance, giving guests plenty of affordable dining choices.

Real guest reviews — what they praise and flag — Across 400-plus reviews on Booking.com, Agoda and Trip.com, the picture is fairly consistent. On the positive side: the pools receive the most consistent praise — repeatedly described as beautiful, clean and peaceful; staff are widely described as friendly and genuinely helpful; rooms are considered clean and spacious for the price; free parking is appreciated by the many guests who drive in from outside Bangkok. On the watch-out side: several reviews report the pool, sauna, and spa being closed for maintenance during their stay — and with no prior notice given — which is a meaningful disappointment if that is the main reason for choosing this hotel. Some reviews mention dusty rooms or corners that could use more thorough cleaning. Noise from neighbouring rooms is noted by a minority of guests, particularly on lower floors.
"Great location for the stadium and university. The pools are a real bonus at this price. Staff went out of their way to help. Would stay again — just ask for a room on a higher floor."

Pricing and value — Typical nightly rates during weekdays and off-peak periods start from around ฿800–900 for a Deluxe Room. Family Rooms begin around ฿1,200. During concerts or major events at Rajamangala, expect prices to climb to ฿1,200–1,800 or higher, often well in advance. Weighing the offer — two pools, gym, spa, restaurant, free parking, and 256 renovated rooms — against prices that start under ฿1,000, Witz delivers solid value by Ramkhamhaeng standards. The caveat is the inconsistency in pool availability and cleaning standards, which can affect the experience if you are unlucky with timing. Book with free cancellation whenever possible and confirm facility status by phone before arrival.

honestSummary: Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng offers more facilities than comparable-priced hotels in the Ramkhamhaeng area — two pools, gym, spa, and free parking are genuine advantages. The main risk is inconsistent pool and spa availability, and cleaning standards that vary between rooms. If your priority is a pool hotel near Ramkhamhaeng University or Rajamangala Stadium without spending 4-star money, this hotel delivers — provided you verify facility status before you check in.
honestChecks: If the pool is the main reason you're booking here — call the hotel before your stay to confirm both pools, the sauna, and the spa are operational. Several reviews report these being closed for maintenance without notice, which significantly changes the value proposition.

If premium cleanliness standards matter to you — cleaning consistency varies between rooms and between stays. Request the most recently renovated room category at check-in, and flag any issues with housekeeping promptly.

If you're visiting during a Rajamangala event — rates spike and rooms fill fast. Book with free cancellation well in advance, and expect a livelier, noisier atmosphere in the surrounding streets during and after events.

faq.q: Where is Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng and what is it near?
faq.a: The hotel is at 8 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 35, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240 — directly opposite Ramkhamhaeng University (2–3 min walk). Rajamangala National Stadium is a 3–5 min Grab ride away. ARL Hua Mak Station (A4) is 1.5 km away with a 27-minute train connection to Suvarnabhumi Airport. The Mall LifeStore Ramkhamhaeng is roughly 2 km away.

faq.q: Does Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — two outdoor pools, plus a gym, sauna and spa. The pools are frequently highlighted in guest reviews as clean, attractive, and peaceful. That said, some guests have reported these facilities being closed for maintenance without advance notice — call ahead to confirm if the pool is a key reason for your booking.

faq.q: How much does Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng cost per night?
faq.a: Standard Deluxe Rooms (26 sq m) typically start from around ฿800–900 per night during off-peak periods. Family Rooms begin around ฿1,200. During concerts or sporting events at Rajamangala Stadium, prices can rise to ฿1,200–1,800 or higher. Book early and choose free cancellation for flexibility.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng?
faq.a: The easiest and cheapest route is ARL from the airport to Hua Mak Station (A4) — about 27 minutes. Then take a Grab or motorcycle taxi for 3–4 minutes to the hotel. Alternatively, Grab direct from the airport takes approximately 25–35 minutes depending on traffic.

faq.q: Who is Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng best suited for?
faq.a: The hotel works particularly well for parents visiting students at Ramkhamhaeng University, families needing a pool and free parking, concert or sports fans attending Rajamangala events, and business travellers working in the Bang Kapi area who want a pool and gym without paying 4-star prices.

faq.q: Is breakfast included at Witz Bangkok Hotel Ramkhamhaeng?
faq.a: No — the breakfast buffet is not included in the room rate. It is available daily from 07:00–10:00 at ฿220 per person, and guest reviews generally consider it decent value.
